notes.title: HUGE UPDATE! - NEW MACHINES, FIXES AND MORE
notes.content:
Hello Chefs!

We're happy to announce Kebab Simulator: Prologue edition's first major update! You can now try out the new Prologue experience!

As we have mentioned before, we will be publishing most of the improvements made on base game also on Prologue. There might be more major updates before the full release! This way, we are aiming to keep you up to date with the latest state of Kebab Simulator.

I will be keeping it short in here and just share the full list of all changes and fixes made from the latest patch. There will be another development update post on Kebab Simulator Steam page very soon which will go more in detail.

Changes:
- Meat Grinder added to game.
- Stand Mixer added to game.
- Dessert slices are now can easily attachable to dessert trays.
- Most of the sliceables are grouped together, you don't have to carry them one by one now.
- Slicing boards are compounded with knife racks.
- Recipe progressions are displayed on day ending screen.
- Restaurant area expanded via changing place of the toilet.

Fixes:
- Fixed issue where players get stuck while opening fridger.
- Localization fixes.
- Issue with meats decayed in mixer bowl displayed as fresh fixed.
- Fixed issue with plate count doubled in plate cabinet.
- Fixed misleading recipe descriptions.

We will be waiting for your feedbacks on [url=https://discord.gg/phyBgJf7CA]Kebab Simulator's discord channel[/url]. You can join us in discord to get notified about all the changes beforehand.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.4
notes.content:
Changes:
- Localization update on English, Spanish, German, Chinese languages.
- Increased mini freezer's height due to item placing difficulty
- In game language changing is not allowed anymore. You should change language in main menu.
- Added tutorial warnings to some actions due to they are being thought as a bug.

Fixes:
- Fixed issue where players can't get to the end of the day.
- Fixed decaying texture issue on ground beef.
- Fixed a collision bug occurs in player's house.
- Fixed some miner localization issues.
